liebermann.description_de: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale Lat. 10575 (früher Suppl. lat. 138)
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France, MS lat. 10575 (formerly Suppl. lat. 138)
liebermann.notes: Contains the Benedictio ignis, Capitula de sacerdotibus and Excarpsum de canonibus, then (ff. 7–172) the so-called Pontificale Egberti in a hand '200 years younger than Egbert', followed by an 11th-century ritual from Évreux, an Old English absolution formula (c. 1000), and after the coronation rite the Sacramentum coronationis (f. 137).
